scripts.title: PCW Kill All
scripts.features:
Kill All Mobs (Must be holding out any weapon in order to work)

Note: It may not work against some bosses but it mostly works against everything.

^ oh ya btw this script was made with chat GPT. i used neutrals script and improved it with chat GPT so the script does way more damage and supports more bosses/mobs so if you want to improve it yourself, feel free to do so! just check the github source in the script and the raw script will be there.

scripts.title: pc kill all fixed
scripts.features: this is a better one that now works with all melee weapons instead of only some and doesnt require you to type in the weapon you want as it automatically detects the weapon
scripts.script:
local game = game
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
local character = localPlayer.Character
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local cd = 0

runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
    character = localPlayer.Character
    local weapon = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
    if cd > 0.005 then
        for _,v in workspace:GetChildren() do
            if v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and v:FindFirstChild("Mob") and v.Mob.Value == true and v.Humanoid.Health > 0 and not players:FindFirstChild(v.Name) and weapon and weapon:FindFirstChild("FEMeleeKitEvents") then
                weapon.FEMeleeKitEvents.Attack.Attack_Server:FireServer(v,"Handle")
            elseif v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and v:FindFirstChild("Mob") and v.Mob.Value == true and v.Humanoid.Health > 0 and not players:FindFirstChild(v.Name) and weapon and weapon:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunction") then
                weapon.RemoteFunction:InvokeServer("hit",{v.Humanoid,100000})
            end
        end
        cd = 0
    end
    cd += delta
end)
